title: Restore the Forest
instruction: Restore a forest route from the West to the East woodland before the rounds run out.
intro: Three forest patches, one road and a lot of damaged ground. The team shares 2 Restoration Capacity each round — choose together where to spend it.

events.title: Lantana spreads
events.text: Invasive Lantana is creeping into the central patch. Cells marked in orange degrade at the end of this round unless the team clears them.

objectives.label: Forest route from West to East woodland

challenge.text: Keep the fruiting fig in the central patch healthy.
